websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Company domains or URLs, one per line (example.com or https://example.com).

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: The home page plus the most contact-like internal pages (contact, about, team, impressum...).

sameDomainEmailsOnly.title: Only emails on the site's own domain
sameDomainEmailsOnly.description: Drops addresses on other domains (for example a web agency's address in the footer).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages the site disallows for all crawlers.
